title: GFCC Signal Envelope v1
description: Machine-to-machine signal entry. Sibling of ask.envelope.v1 (human dialogue). Signals are user-action-generated facts, never AI self-attestation. Does not go through POST /v1/ask, llm slot, or ethos quota.

user_id_hash.description: sha256(email.lower().trim()); hash only, never plaintext email

nonce.description: client-generated unique value, uuid4 hex; idempotency key component

timestamp.description: Optional ISO 8601 UTC; audit only, not part of idempotency

payload.description: Strict object. Shape selected by signal_type via payload_by_type.

red_lines: payload carries hash and typed results only; no plaintext email, raw answers, or peer identity
signal must originate from a real user action (confirm match, finish assessment); never AI self-attestation
